transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. Um... well, I came in because for the past few weeks, I’ve just felt this heavy, sad pressure sitting on me almost all day. I'm a nurse, and even when I’m at work, you know, smiling at my patients... inside I just feel like I’m barely holding myself together.
Have you been feeling down like this most days for at least the past two years?
No, definitely not two years. Um, it's really just been going on for about three weeks now. It started shortly after I found out I was pregnant.
Do you feel that finding out you were pregnant is what triggered these feelings?
I'm honestly not sure. Um... the timing definitely lines up, since it started right around then, but... I don't really know if it's the actual cause. I just know that's when this heavy feeling began.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah, I have. Usually, after my shifts, I used to paint or go to yoga or salsa to decompress. But lately... I just go straight home and sit on the couch. I've been ignoring texts from people because... I don't know, none of it feels worth the effort right now.
Have these feelings been making it hard for you to function in your daily life?

Yeah, it has. I mean, I’m still making it to work, but... my supervisor has already noticed some incomplete charting on my end. And outside of work, like I mentioned, I’ve just been pulling away from my friends and all the things that usually keep me steady.
Along with feeling down, have you also been feeling anxious or worried much of the time?

Not really, no. Um... I wouldn't say I feel anxious or worried. It's more just... like I said, a heavy feeling. I'm not really stressing or panicking about things, I just feel really drained and, I don't know, empty, I guess.
Before this started three weeks ago, have you ever had another period in your life when you felt depressed like this for at least two weeks?
No, I haven't. I mean, I've had bad days before, like anyone, but... never anything like this where it just stays with me day after day. This is the first time I've felt this way for this long.
Since learning you were pregnant, have you been feeling stressed or overwhelmed by that news?

Oh, um... I'm actually not pregnant. I'm not sure if there's a mistake in my chart or if you have me confused with someone else, but no, I'm definitely not pregnant. So... that's not something I'm stressing over.
Did something stressful happen in your life shortly before these feelings started?

No, not really. I've actually thought about that, but... nothing major happened. Everything was pretty much just normal at work and at home. There wasn't any big event or sudden stress that I can point to. It just sort of... started.
